items.difficulty_reason: The lemma constructs the Cech-to-cohomology spectral sequence of a covering, with E_2 page the Cech cohomology with coefficients in the cohomology presheaves, converging to the cohomology of the covered object, functorially in the sheaf (statement lines 1474-1484). The proof builds the relevant double complex from the Cech complex and an injective resolution (proof lines 1486-1495), identifies the E_2 page (proof lines 1495-1500) and reads off convergence and functoriality (proof lines 1500-1503). The non-formal content is the identification of the E_2 page. The claim is H2: one double complex and one page computation.
